import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def minimal_layers(N):
    segments = [(i, j) for i in range(N + 1) for j in range(i + 1, N + 1)]
    
    def overlap(seg1, seg2):
        return not (seg1[1] <= seg2[0] or seg2[1] <= seg1[0])
    
    layers = []
    
    for segment in segments:
        placed = False
        for layer in layers:
            if all(not overlap(segment, placed_segment) for placed_segment in layer):
                layer.append(segment)
                placed = True
                break
        if not placed:
            layers.append([segment])
    
    return len(layers)

def main():
    N = int(input().strip())
    print(minimal_layers(N))

main()
```
